spec.hypothesis: Extend XGBoost/LightGBM baseline to 3 cells with unified evaluation protocol (run_cv). Fix AUC protocol inconsistency (old RF d0v1=0.861 vs XGBoost d0v1=1.000 was evaluation artifact).

experiment_data.notes: 3-cell × 3-classifier (RF/XGBoost/LightGBM) with unified run_cv evaluation. Key findings: (1) All 3 classifiers converge within ≤0.5pp per cell — signal ceiling is in 19-dim features, not classifier choice. (2) Unified AUC protocol resolved prior inconsistency: RF d0v1 AUC=0.9996 (was 0.861 under old protocol) now matches XGBoost d0v1=0.9999. (3) d2 recall remains lowest across all cells/classifiers (43-73%), confirming feature-level limitation. (4) Cell difficulty ordering preserved: gpt2xl_temp09 (86%) > pythia_nuc (79%) > pythia_topk50 (69%). Script: src/xgb_lgbm_3cell.py. Data had inf/extreme values handled via percentile clipping.
